discription: A basic pulse wave with a low-pass filter and ADSR envelope, allowing control over pulse width and filter cutoff.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, width=0.5, lpfCutoff=4000;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, width);    sig = LPF.ar(sig, lpfCutoff);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
